design.cache: warm OS cache; every block opens and verifies/warmups before query timing; no eviction
design.source_validation: complete source check before timed search; unchanged CRC/schema/key/version checks

interpretation: Short exclusive sessions, per-block source validation/warmup outside timing; two resident oracle workers, no concurrent database queries. Not identical to a continuously open single-process matrix. Pooled p95 and block medians describe different distributions; no automatic significance claim.
